text:
leo: heads up, release/2026.03.22 canary stuck in promote. deploy-bot paused due to build artifact validation failing (checksum mismatch).

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: release/2026.03.22. Failed checks: artifact-validate (checksum mismatch).

anya: logs show uploader returned 200 but digest differs when pulled by staging runner. suspect parallel upload / registry eventual consistency.

ci-runner: repro attempt: pulled image digest locally -> mismatch. raising a reupload job.

leo: options: 1) reupload artifact and retry promote, 2) pin to prior image that passed, 3) hold until registry team investigates. Change window ends in 90m.

anya: reupload + retry now. If it still fails, fallback to pin.

leo: ok reuploading and kicking CI. tagging new artifact: gcr.io/redwood/release:2026-03-22-reupload-1

ci-runner: reupload completed, runner pulling new image for staging-smoke.

ci-runner: staging-smoke passed on reupload. deploy-bot: resumed promotion.

deploy-bot: Promotion completed at 2026-03-22T16:45:12Z. Release promoted to prod. Note: Registry team ticket created: RG-987 (investigate digest flip under high parallel uploads).

leo: leaving follow-up: add post-deploy artifact checksum verification step to release pipeline and doc the fallback pin process.

anya: will draft the pipeline change and link RG-987.
